title.zh: 卷十一 本紀第十一 景帝
title.raw: 卷十一 本紀第十一 景帝 Volume 11 Annals 11: Emperor Jing

sentences.zh: 恭仁康定景皇帝，諱祁鈺，宣宗次子也。

translations.literal: The Jing Emperor, with posthumous style Respectful, Benevolent, Tranquil, and Settled, taboo name Qiyu, was the Xuanzong Emperor's second son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing—honored after death as Gongren Kangding Jing—was named Zhu Qiyu and was the second son of Emperor Xuanzong.

sentences.zh: 母賢妃吳氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Worthy Consort Wu.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Worthy Consort Wu.

sentences.zh: 英宗即位，封郕王。

translations.literal: When the Yingzong Emperor took the throne, he was enfeoffed Prince of Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingzong ascended the throne, Zhu Qiyu was enfeoffed as Prince of Cheng.

sentences.zh: 正統十四年秋八月，英宗北狩，皇太后命王監國。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn in Zhengtong year fourteen, the Yingzong Emperor went on a northern hunt; the Empress Dowager ordered the Prince to oversee the realm as regent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Zhengtong fourteen the Yingzong Emperor was borne north; the Empress Dowager charged the Prince of Cheng with regency.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，移通州糧入京師。

translations.literal: On bingyin grain from Tongzhou was moved into the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin grain stores at Tongzhou were shifted into Beijing.

sentences.zh: 徵兩畿、山東、河南備倭運糧諸軍入 ，召寧陽侯陳懋帥師還。

translations.literal: Troops of the two capitals circuits, Shandong, and Henan who transported grain for anti-pirate operations were recalled; Baron of Ningyang Chen Mao was summoned to lead his army back.
translations.idiomatic: Armies from the metropolitan districts, Shandong, and Henan engaged in anti-pirate grain transport were called in; Chen Mao, Baron of Ningyang, was ordered to march home.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，兵部侍郎于謙為本部尚書。

translations.literal: On wuchen Vice Minister of War Yu Qian was made Minister of the same ministry.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Yu Qian, vice minister of war, was promoted minister of war.

sentences.zh: 令 臣直言時事，舉人材。

translations.literal: An order: officials were to speak frankly on current affairs and recommend men of talent.
translations.idiomatic: The court commanded officials to speak plainly on affairs of the day and to put forward able men.

sentences.zh: 己巳，皇太后詔立皇子見深為皇太子。

translations.literal: On jisi the Empress Dowager issued an edict establishing the Prince's son Jianshen as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Empress Dowager had Zhu Jianshen, the regent's son, named crown prince.

sentences.zh: 卹陣亡將士。

translations.literal: Comfort was extended to officers and soldiers who fell in battle.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted relief to the families of troops killed in action.

sentences.zh: 庚午，籍王振家。

translations.literal: On gengwu the household registers of Wang Zhen's family were seized.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Wang Zhen's estate was inventoried and confiscated.

sentences.zh: 辛未，右都御史陳鎰撫安畿內軍民。

translations.literal: On xinwei Right Censor-in-chief Chen Yi was sent to pacify troops and civilians within the metropolitan districts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Chen Yi, right censor-in-chief, was dispatched to reassure army and populace in the capital region.

sentences.zh: 壬申，都督石亨總京營兵。

translations.literal: On renshen Regional Commander Shi Heng took overall command of the capital garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Shi Heng was made commander-in-chief of the capital camps.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，諭邊將，瓦剌奉駕至，不得輕出。

translations.literal: On yihai frontier generals were instructed: if the Oirats bring the Emperor in escort, they must not sally lightly.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai border commanders were warned not to venture out rashly should the Oirats march the captive emperor before them.

sentences.zh: 輸南京軍器於京師。

translations.literal: Military stores of Nanjing were transported to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Arms and equipment from Nanjing were shipped to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 修撰商輅、彭時入閣預機務。

translations.literal: Hanlin compilers Shang Lu and Peng Shi entered the Grand Secretariat to participate in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shang Lu and Peng Shi, compilers of the Hanlin Academy, joined the Grand Secretariat to deliberate state secrets.

sentences.zh: 是月，廣東賊黃蕭養作亂。

translations.literal: That month the Guangdong bandit Huang Xiaoyang rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In that month Huang Xiaoyang raised rebellion in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，王即皇帝位，遙尊皇帝為太上皇帝，以明年為景泰元年，大赦天下，免景泰二年田租十之三。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on guimao the Prince ascended the throne, honored the Emperor from afar as Retired Emperor, made the coming year Jingtai year one, proclaimed a general amnesty, and remitted one-third of the field tax of Jingtai year two.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao, the Prince of Cheng took the throne as Emperor Jingtai, saluted the captive Yingzong as Retired Emperor from afar, declared the next year the first of Jingtai, proclaimed an amnesty, and cut field tax for Jingtai two by one-third.

sentences.zh: 甲申，夷王振族。

translations.literal: On jiashen Wang Zhen's clan was exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the house of Wang Zhen was annihilated to the last male.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，處州賊平。

translations.literal: On gengyin the bandits of Chuzhou were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Chuzhou rebels were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，指揮僉事季鐸奉皇太后命，達於上皇。

translations.literal: On guisi Commandant Ji Duo, by the Empress Dowager's order, reached the Retired Emperor with her message.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Ji Duo, a commandant, delivered the Empress Dowager's words to the Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，祭宣府、土木陣亡將士 瘞遺骸。

translations.literal: On jiawu sacrifice was offered to officers and soldiers who fell at Xuanfu and Tumu; scattered remains were buried.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the court sacrificed to the dead of Xuanfu and Tumu and interred such bones as could be gathered.

sentences.zh: 乙未，總兵官安鄉伯張安討廣州賊，敗死。

translations.literal: On yiwei Commander-in-chief Zhang An, Baron of Anxiang, campaigned against Guangzhou bandits and was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Zhang An, Baron of Anxiang and overall commander, marched against Guangzhou rebels, was beaten, and died.

sentences.zh: 指揮僉事王清被執，死之。

translations.literal: Commandant Wang Qing was captured and died.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant Wang Qing was taken and killed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，給事中孫祥、郎中羅通為右副都御史，守紫荊、居庸關。

translations.literal: On xinchou Supervising Secretary Sun Xiang and Director Luo Tong were made right vice censors-in-chief and stationed at Zijing and Juyong passes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Sun Xiang, supervising secretary, and Luo Tong, director, were made right vice censors-in-chief to hold Zijing and Juyong passes.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣御史十五人募兵畿內、山東、山西、河南。

translations.literal: On jiachen fifteen censors were dispatched to raise troops in the metropolitan districts, Shandong, Shanxi, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen fifteen investigating censors were sent to levy men in the capital region, Shandong, Shanxi, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 都督同知陳友帥師討湖廣、貴州叛苗。

translations.literal: Vice Regional Commander Chen You led troops to suppress rebellious Miao in Huguang and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chen You, vice regional commander, took the field against Miao rebels in Huguang and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣使奉書上皇。

translations.literal: On yisi envoys were sent bearing letters to the Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi messengers were dispatched with written greetings to the Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 丙午，苗圍平越 ，調雲南、四川兵會王驥討之。

translations.literal: On bingwu Miao besieged Pingyue; troops of Yunnan and Sichuan were mobilized to join Wang Ji in suppressing them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Miao forces besieged Pingyue; Yunnan and Sichuan troops were called up to campaign under Wang Ji.

sentences.zh: 參議楊信民為右僉都御史，討廣東賊。

translations.literal: Participating Secretary Yang Xinmin was made right vice censor-in-chief to suppress Guangdong bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xinmin, a participating secretary, was made right vice censor-in-chief and sent against the Guangdong rebels.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，也先擁上皇至大同。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on wushen, Esen brought the Retired Emperor to Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen, Esen marched the Retired Emperor to Datong.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔諸王勤王。

translations.literal: On renzi an edict summoned the imperial princes to raise armies for the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi princes throughout the realm were ordered to muster in aid of the court.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，于謙提督諸營，石亨及諸將分守九門。

translations.literal: On yimao Yu Qian took overall supervision of the camps; Shi Heng and the generals divided defense of the Nine Gates.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Yu Qian assumed supreme direction of the capital armies while Shi Heng and the other commanders garrisoned the Nine Gates.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，也先陷紫荊關，孫祥死之，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: On bingchen Esen seized Zijing Pass; Sun Xiang died; the capital was placed under martial law.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Esen broke through Zijing Pass; Sun Xiang fell; Beijing went on full alert.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔宣府、遼東總兵官，山東、河南、山西、陝西巡撫及募兵御史將兵入援。

translations.literal: On dingsi an edict ordered commanders-in-chief of Xuanfu and Liaodong, grand coordinators of Shandong, Henan, Shanxi, and Shaanxi, and censors raising troops to march in relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi regional commanders of Xuanfu and Liaodong, grand coordinators on four circuits, and censors recruiting levies were all commanded to hurry reinforcements to the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊午，也先薄都城，都督高禮、毛福壽敗之於彰義門。

translations.literal: On wuwu Esen pressed the capital; Regional Commander Gao Li and Mao Shoufu defeated him at Zhangyi Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Esen closed on the city; Gao Li and Mao Shoufu beat him back at Zhangyi Gate.

sentences.zh: 己未，右通政王復、太常少卿趙榮使也先營，[一]朝上皇於土城。

translations.literal: On jiwei Right Vice Commissioner Wang Fu and Vice Minister of Rites Zhao Rong went to Esen's camp; [1] they paid court to the Retired Emperor at Tucheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Wang Fu, right vice commissioner of the transmission office, and Zhao Rong, vice minister of rites, entered Esen's camp and were received by the Retired Emperor at Tucheng.

sentences.zh: 庚申，徵兵於朝鮮，調河州諸 土軍入援。

translations.literal: On gengshen troops were levied in Korea; various native troops of Hezhou were mobilized for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen levies were ordered in Korea and native forces of Hezhou were called to the capital's aid.

sentences.zh: 于謙、石亨等連敗也先於城下。

translations.literal: Yu Qian, Shi Heng, and others repeatedly defeated Esen below the walls.
translations.idiomatic: Below the walls Yu Qian, Shi Heng, and their colleagues drove Esen back again and again.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，寇退。

translations.literal: On renxu the raiders withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the enemy lifted the siege and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 甲子，出紫荊關。

translations.literal: On jiazi they marched out through Zijing Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Oirat host passed out by Zijing Pass.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔止諸王兵。

translations.literal: On dingmao an edict halted the princes' armies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the court ordered the princes' relief columns to stand down.

sentences.zh: 瓦剌可汗脫脫不花使來。

translations.literal: The Oirat khan Toghon Taishi sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Toghon Taishi, khan of the Oirats, dispatched an embassy.

sentences.zh: 辛未，昌平伯楊洪充總兵官，都督孫鏜、范廣副之，剿畿內餘寇。

translations.literal: On xinwei Baron of Changping Yang Hong was made commander-in-chief; Regional Commanders Sun Tang and Fan Guang served as his deputies, to mop up remaining bandits in the metropolitan districts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Yang Hong, Baron of Changping, became overall commander with Sun Tang and Fan Guang as lieutenants to clear stragglers from the capital region.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，修沿邊關隘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on guimao frontier passes and barriers were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guimao, border fortifications along the frontier were rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，毛福壽為副總兵，討辰州叛苗。

translations.literal: On xinmao Mao Shoufu was made deputy commander-in-chief to suppress rebellious Miao in Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Mao Shoufu was appointed deputy overall commander against the Chenzhou Miao.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上皇至瓦剌。

translations.literal: On renchen the Retired Emperor reached the Oirat lands.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the Retired Emperor was brought into Oirat territory.

sentences.zh: 乙未，侍郎耿九疇撫安南畿流民，賜復三年。

translations.literal: On yiwei Vice Minister Geng Jiuzhou pacified displaced people in the southern capital districts and granted three years' tax remission.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Geng Jiuzhou, vice minister, settled refugees south of the capital and gave them three years without tax.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，尊皇太后為上聖皇太后。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on gengxu the Empress Dowager was honored Supreme Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengxu, the empress dowager was elevated supreme empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，王驥為平蠻將軍，充總兵官，討貴州叛苗。

translations.literal: On xinhai Wang Ji was made General Who Pacifies the Barbarians and commander-in-chief to suppress rebellious Miao in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Wang Ji received the title General Who Pacifies the Barbarians and overall command of the Guizhou Miao campaign.

sentences.zh: 都督同知董興為左副總兵，討廣東賊，戶部侍郎孟鑑參贊軍務。

translations.literal: Vice Regional Commander Dong Xing was made left deputy commander-in-chief to suppress Guangdong bandits; Vice Minister of Revenue Meng Jian assisted in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Xing, vice regional commander, became left deputy overall commander against Guangdong rebels; Meng Jian, vice minister of revenue, joined the staff.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，尊母賢妃為皇太后。

translations.literal: On guichou the mother, Worthy Consort, was honored Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the emperor's mother, Worthy Consort Wu, was made empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，立妃汪氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On jiayin Consort Wang was established Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Consort Wang was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，大赦。

translations.literal: On bingchen a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen a general pardon was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 己未，石亨、楊洪、柳溥分練京營兵。

translations.literal: On jiwei Shi Heng, Yang Hong, and Liu Pu divided training of the capital garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Shi Heng, Yang Hong, and Liu Pu were assigned to drill the capital camps by rotation.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，祭陣亡官軍於西直門外。

translations.literal: On wuchen officers and soldiers who fell in battle were sacrificed to outside Xizhi Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the court sacrificed to the war dead west of Xizhi Gate.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球中山、占城、烏斯藏、撒馬兒罕入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu Chuzan, Champa, U-Tsang, and Samarkand sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies came from Chuzan of Ryukyu, Champa, U-Tsang, and Samarkand.

sentences.zh: 景泰元年

translations.literal: Jingtai year one
translations.idiomatic: Year one of Jingtai

sentences.zh: 景泰元年春正月丁丑朔，罷朝賀。

translations.literal: Jingtai year one, spring, first month, on dingchou new moon, court congratulations were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in Jingtai one, at the new moon on dingchou, the New Year audience was canceled.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，城昌平。

translations.literal: On xinsi the walls of Changping were built.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi fortifications at Changping were raised.

sentences.zh: 壬午，享太廟。

translations.literal: On renwu the Ancestral Temple was feasted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the emperor offered at the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On bingxu the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he performed the suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲寅，瓦剌寇寧夏。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on jiayin, Oirat raiders attacked Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiayin, Oirat bands struck Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔會試取士毋拘額。

translations.literal: On guihai an edict: metropolitan graduates were not to be limited by quota.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the court ordered that palace graduates need not be held to a fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 庚午，大同總兵官郭登敗瓦剌於沙窩，又追敗之於栲栳山，封登定襄伯。

translations.literal: On gengwu Commander-in-chief of Datong Guo Deng defeated the Oirats at Shawo and again pursued and defeated them at Kaolaoshan; Deng was enfeoffed Baron of Dingxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Guo Deng, commander at Datong, routed the Oirats at Shawo and again at Kaolaoshan; he was made Baron of Dingxiang.

sentences.zh: 是月，免大名、真定、開封、輝被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That month tax grain was remitted in disaster-stricken Daming, Zhending, Kaifeng, and Weihui.
translations.idiomatic: That month grain tax was forgiven in flood-hit Daming, Zhending, Kaifeng, and Weihui.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，耕耤田。

translations.literal: In the second month on wuyin the emperor plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuyin, he performed the spring plowing rite.

sentences.zh: 癸未，懸賞格招陷敵軍民。

translations.literal: On guimao a reward schedule was posted to recruit civilians and soldiers trapped among the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao posted rewards promised safe return to subjects and troops held in enemy hands.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，石亨為鎮朔大將軍，帥師巡大同。

translations.literal: On bingxu Shi Heng was made Grand General Who Pacifies the North and led troops to patrol Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Shi Heng was titled Grand General Who Pacifies the North and marched to patrol the Datong front.

sentences.zh: 都指揮同知楊能充遊擊將軍，巡宣府。

translations.literal: Vice Commandant Yang Neng was made mobile corps general and patrolled Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Neng, vice commandant, became mobile corps general with patrol duty at Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太監喜寧伏誅。

translations.literal: On renchen the eunuch Xi Ning was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the eunuch Xi Ning was put to death.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，瓦剌寇朔州。

translations.literal: In the third month on jiyou Oirat raiders attacked Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiyou, Oirat forces raided Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，錄土木死事諸臣後。

translations.literal: On xinhai the descendants of officials who died at Tumu were recorded and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the court enrolled and ennobled the kin of ministers who perished at Tumu.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，瓦剌寇寧夏、慶陽．乙卯，寇朔州。

translations.literal: On guichou Oirat raiders attacked Ningxia and Qingyang; on yimao they raided Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the Oirats struck Ningxia and Qingyang; on yimao they struck Shuozhou again.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，免畿內逋賦及夏稅。

translations.literal: On gengshen arrears of tax and summer levy within the metropolitan districts were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen overdue taxes and the summer assessment were forgiven in the capital region.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子，廣東都指揮李昇、何貴帥兵捕海賊，戰死。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on bingzi Regional Commanders of Guangdong Li Sheng and He Gui led troops to capture sea bandits and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingzi, Li Sheng and He Gui, Guangdong regional commanders, took the sea rebels and were killed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，瓦剌寇大同，官軍擊之。

translations.literal: On xinsi Oirat raiders attacked Datong; government troops repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Oirat columns hit Datong; the garrison drove them off.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，保定伯梁代王驥討貴州叛苗。

translations.literal: On dinghai Baron of Baoding Liang Li replaced Wang Ji in suppressing rebellious Miao in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Liang Li, Baron of Baoding, relieved Wang Ji in the Guizhou Miao campaign.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大理寺丞李茂錄囚南京，考黜百司，訪軍民利病。

translations.literal: On wuzi Assistant Director of the Court of Judicial Review Li Mao recorded prisoners in Nanjing, examined and dismissed officials of the hundred offices, and inquired into the welfare of troops and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Li Mao, an assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review, reviewed cases in Nanjing, graded the bureaucracy, and investigated grievances of army and people.

sentences.zh: 丙申，瓦剌寇雁門。

translations.literal: On bingshen Oirat raiders attacked Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the Oirats raided Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 己亥，都督同知劉安充總兵官，練兵於保定、真定及涿、易、通三州，僉都御史曹泰參贊軍務。

translations.literal: On jihai Vice Regional Commander Liu An was made commander-in-chief and drilled troops at Baoding, Zhending, and the three prefectures Zhuo, Yi, and Tong; Vice Censor-in-chief Cao Tai assisted in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Liu An, vice regional commander, became overall commander to train forces at Baoding, Zhending, and Zhuo, Yi, and Tong; Cao Tai, vice censor-in-chief, joined his staff.

sentences.zh: 庚子，振山東饑。

translations.literal: On gengzi famine relief was extended in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi grain was issued to relieve famine in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，振畿內被寇州縣。

translations.literal: On xinchou districts and counties of the metropolitan region ravaged by raiders were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the court aided counties in the capital region plundered by the enemy.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，瓦剌寇大同，郭登擊之。

translations.literal: On guimao Oirat raiders attacked Datong; Guo Deng repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Oirats again struck Datong; Guo Deng beat them back.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，免山西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on yisi tax grain was remitted in disaster-stricken Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yisi, field tax was forgiven in stricken parts of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 瓦剌掠河曲、代州，遂南犯，詔劉安督涿、易諸軍禦之。

translations.literal: The Oirats plundered Hequ and Daizhou, then marched south; an edict ordered Liu An to command the Zhuo and Yi armies to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Oirat bands looted Hequ and Daizhou and turned south; Liu An was ordered to lead the Zhuo–Yi corps against them.

sentences.zh: 戊申，瓦剌寇雁門，益黃花鎮戍兵陵寢，癸丑，董興擊破廣東賊，黃蕭養伏誅。

translations.literal: On wushen Oirat raiders attacked Yanmen; garrison at Huanghua town was increased to guard the imperial tombs; on guichou Dong Xing routed Guangdong bandits and Huang Xiaoyang was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Oirats hit Yanmen and the Huanghua garrison was strengthened to protect the tombs; on guichou Dong Xing crushed the Guangdong rebels and Huang Xiaoyang was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，振大同被寇軍民。

translations.literal: On renxu troops and civilians of Datong ravaged by raiders were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the court aided Datong's army and people after the raids.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，侍郎侯璡、副總兵田禮大破貴州苗。

translations.literal: On bingyin Vice Minister Hou Lin and Deputy Commander Tian Li greatly defeated the Guizhou Miao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Hou Lin, vice minister, and Tian Li, deputy commander, inflicted a heavy defeat on the Guizhou Miao.

sentences.zh: 辛未，瓦剌遣使請和。

translations.literal: On xinwei the Oirats sent envoys suing for peace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Oirats dispatched envoys to seek peace.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，瓦剌寇大同，郭登擊之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on renwu Oirat raiders attacked Datong; Guo Deng repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renwu, the Oirats raided Datong and Guo Deng drove them off.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，也先復擁上皇至大同。

translations.literal: On bingxu Esen again brought the Retired Emperor to Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Esen once more escorted the Retired Emperor to Datong.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，左都御史陳鎰、王文以鞫太監金英家人不實下獄，尋釋之。

translations.literal: On dinghai Left Censor-in-chief Chen Yi and Wang Wen were imprisoned for trying the household of eunuch Jin Ying on false charges; soon they were released.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Chen Yi, left censor-in-chief, and Wang Wen were jailed for an unfounded inquest into eunuch Jin Ying's family, then freed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，瓦剌寇宣府，都督朱謙、參將紀廣禦之。

translations.literal: On wuzi Oirat raiders attacked Xuanfu; Regional Commander Zhu Qian and Participating General Ji Guang repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Oirats struck Xuanfu; Zhu Qian, regional commander, and Ji Guang, participating general, turned them back.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，免山東被災州縣稅糧。

translations.literal: On wuxu tax grain was remitted in disaster-stricken counties of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu field tax was forgiven in afflicted Shandong counties.

sentences.zh: 己亥，給事中李實、大理寺丞羅綺使瓦剌。

translations.literal: On jihai Supervising Secretary Li Shi and Assistant Director Luo Qi were sent as envoys to the Oirats.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Li Shi, supervising secretary, and Luo Qi, assistant director, were dispatched to the Oirat court.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，尚書侯璡、參將方瑛破貴州苗，擒其酋獻京師。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on gengxu Minister Hou Lin and Participating General Fang Ying defeated Guizhou Miao, captured their chieftain, and presented him at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengxu, Hou Lin and Fang Ying broke the Guizhou Miao, seized their leader, and sent him to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 庚申，右都御史楊善、工部侍郎趙榮使瓦剌。

translations.literal: On gengshen Right Censor-in-chief Yang Shan and Vice Minister of Works Zhao Rong were sent as envoys to the Oirats.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Yang Shan, right censor-in-chief, and Zhao Rong, vice minister of works, went on embassy to the Oirats.

sentences.zh: 停山西民運糧大同。

translations.literal: Shanxi civilians' transport of grain to Datong was halted.
translations.idiomatic: The court stopped drafting Shanxi civilians to haul grain to Datong.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，李實、羅綺還。

translations.literal: On guihai Li Shi and Luo Qi returned.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Li Shi and Luo Qi came back from their mission.

sentences.zh: 己巳，楊善至瓦剌，也先許上皇歸。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Yang Shan reached the Oirats; Esen promised the Retired Emperor's return.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Yang Shan reached the Oirat camp; Esen agreed to send the Retired Emperor home.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉，上皇發瓦剌。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day guiyou, the Retired Emperor set out from the Oirats.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guiyou, the Retired Emperor left the Oirat lands.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，祀社稷。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the court offered sacrifice at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 甲申，遣侍讀商輅迎上皇於居庸關。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Lecturing Reader Shang Lu was dispatched to welcome the Retired Emperor at Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Lecturing Reader Shang Lu was sent to welcome the Retired Emperor at Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上皇還京師，帝迎於東安門，入居南宮，帝帥百官朝謁。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the Retired Emperor returned to the capital; the Emperor welcomed him at the Eastern Peace Gate; he entered and dwelt in the Southern Palace, and the Emperor led the hundred officials in audience.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the Retired Emperor came back to the capital; the Emperor met him at the Eastern Peace Gate and installed him in the Southern Palace, then led the whole bureaucracy in audience.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，刑部右侍郎江淵兼翰林學士，直文淵閣，預機務。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Vice Minister of Justice Jiang Yuan was concurrently made a Hanlin academician, entered the Grand Secretariat, and participated in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Vice Minister of Justice Jiang Yuan was also appointed Hanlin academician, entered the Grand Secretariat, and joined in state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，巡撫河南副都御史王來總督湖廣、貴州軍務，討叛苗。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guichou, Wang Lai, Vice Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Henan, was made supreme commander of military affairs in Huguang and Guizhou to campaign against rebel Miao.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guichou, Wang Lai, grand coordinator of Henan, was put in overall command of Huguang and Guizhou to suppress rebel Miao.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，錄囚。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day xinmao, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinmao, the court held a prison review.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，免畿內逋賦。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, overdue levies within the metropolitan districts were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi overdue taxes in the capital region were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，禮部尚書胡請令百官賀上皇萬壽節。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day xinhai, Minister of Rites Hu Ying requested that the hundred officials congratulate the Retired Emperor on his longevity festival.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinhai, Minister of Rites Hu Ying asked that all officials observe the Retired Emperor's longevity festival.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，復請明年正旦百官朝上皇於延安門。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day bingshen, he again requested that at the coming New Year's day the hundred officials attend the Retired Emperor at the Yan'an Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingshen, he again asked that at next New Year's the officials attend the Retired Emperor at the Yan'an Gate.

sentences.zh: 皆不許。

translations.literal: Both requests were denied.
translations.idiomatic: Both requests were refused.

sentences.zh: 是年，朝鮮貢馬者三。

translations.literal: That year, Korea sent tribute horses on three occasions.
translations.idiomatic: That year Korea presented tribute horses three times.

sentences.zh: 景泰二年

translations.literal: The second year of Jingtai.
translations.idiomatic: The second year of the Jingtai reign.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on the day gengxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the first month of spring, on gengxu, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔天下朝覲官當黜者運糧口外。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, an edict ordered officials coming to court audience who were due for dismissal to transport grain beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the throne ordered officials marked for dismissal at the audience circuit to haul grain beyond the frontier passes.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，釋奠於先師孔子。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinwei, the seasonal offering was made to the First Teacher Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinwei, the court made the seasonal offering to Confucius.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以星變修省，詔廷臣條議寬卹諸政。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, because of a change in the stars, austerity and self-examination were ordered; the court ministers were commanded to memorialize policies of leniency and relief in all branches of government.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, after a celestial omen, the Emperor entered a period of rectification and ordered the court to draft measures of leniency and relief across the administration.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔畿內及山東巡撫官舉廉能吏專司勸農，授民荒田，貸牛種。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, an edict ordered grand coordinators within the metropolitan districts and in Shandong to recommend upright and capable officials to devote themselves solely to encouraging agriculture, grant the people waste land, and lend oxen and seed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the throne told grand coordinators in the capital region and Shandong to nominate able officials for farm promotion, to assign wasteland to the people, and to lend oxen and seed.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，賜柯潛等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renyin, Ke Qian and other jinshi were granted ranked honors of metropolitan graduate and lower degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renyin, Ke Qian and other jinshi received metropolitan graduate and lower degrees in graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，梁、王來等破平越苗，獻俘京師。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day yiyou, Liang Yu, Wang Lai, and others defeated the Pingyue Miao and presented captives at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou, Liang Yu, Wang Lai, and others broke the Pingyue Miao and sent captives to the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲午，瓦剌寇宣府馬營，敕遊擊將軍石彪等巡邊。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the Oirats raided the Horse Camp at Xuanfu; an imperial command ordered Mobile-Column General Shi Biao and others to patrol the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Oirat forces raided the Horse Camp at Xuanfu; the Emperor ordered Mobile-Column General Shi Biao and others to patrol the border.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命石亨選京營兵操練，尚書石璞總督軍務。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Shi Heng was ordered to select capital-garrison troops for drill; Minister Shi Pu was made supreme commander of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Shi Heng was told to choose capital troops for training, and Minister Shi Pu was made supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，城固原。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day yisi, the walls of Guyuan were built.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yisi, work went forward on the walls of Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰朔，日當食不見。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the new moon day wuchen, an eclipse was due but not seen.
translations.idiomatic: At the new moon of the sixth month, wuchen, an eclipse was predicted but never appeared.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔貴州各修舉屯田。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, an edict ordered every guard in Guizhou to restore and maintain garrison farms.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the throne ordered every Guizhou guard to revive its garrison farms.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，普定、永寧、畢節諸苗復叛，梁等留軍討之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day wushen, the Miao of Puding, Yongning, Bijie, and other districts rebelled again; Liang Yu and others left troops behind to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wushen, the Miao of Puding, Yongning, Bijie, and neighboring districts rose again; Liang Yu and others kept forces in the field to crush them.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，南京地震。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day renshen, Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renshen, Nanjing suffered an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，復午朝。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the noon audience was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the midday audience at court was restored.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，禁諸司起復。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day yimao, all offices were forbidden to recall officials from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yimao, every department was forbidden to recall men still in mourning.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己丑，免山西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jichou, disaster-stricken tax grain in Shanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jichou, grain tax was waived in the stricken districts of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，禮部左侍郎王一寧、祭酒蕭鎡兼翰林學士，直文淵閣，預機務。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengyin, Vice Minister of Rites Wang Yining and Libationer Xiao Zi were concurrently made Hanlin academicians, entered the Grand Secretariat, and participated in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengyin, Vice Minister of Rites Wang Yining and Libationer Xiao Zi were also appointed Hanlin academicians, entered the Grand Secretariat, and joined in state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 是月，也先弒其主脫脫不花。

translations.literal: That month, Esen murdered his lord Toghon Buhua.
translations.idiomatic: That month Esen murdered his khan Toghon Buhua.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、琉球中山、瓦剌、哈密入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Annam, Ryukyu Chuzan, the Oirats, and Hami sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies came from Annam, Ryukyu Chuzan, the Oirats, and Hami.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年

translations.literal: The third year of Jingtai.
translations.idiomatic: The third year of the Jingtai reign.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙午，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on the day bingwu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the first month of spring, on bingwu, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，副都御史劉廣衡錄南京囚。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yiyou, Vice Censor-in-Chief Liu Guangheng reviewed prisoners at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiyou, Vice Censor-in-Chief Liu Guangheng held a prison review at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 戊子，戶部尚書金濂以違詔下獄，尋釋之。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Minister of Revenue Jin Lian was cast into prison for violating an edict; before long he was released.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Revenue Minister Jin Lian was jailed for defying an edict, then soon freed.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，毛福壽討湖廣巴馬苗，克之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuwu, Mao Shou campaigned against the Bama Miao in Huguang and took them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuwu, Mao Shou campaigned against the Bama Miao in Huguang and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲午，廢皇太子見深為沂王，立皇子見濟為皇太子。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on the day jiawu, the Crown Prince Jian Shen was deposed and made Prince of Yi; the imperial son Jianji was established as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on jiawu, Crown Prince Jian Shen was demoted to Prince of Yi and the Emperor's son Jianji was named crown prince.

sentences.zh: 廢皇后汪氏，立太子母杭氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Empress Wang was deposed, and the crown prince's mother, Lady Hang, was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wang was deposed and the crown prince's mother, Lady Hang, was made empress.

sentences.zh: 封上皇子見清榮王，見淳許王。

translations.literal: The Retired Emperor's sons Jianqing and Jianchun were enfeoffed as Prince of Rong and Prince of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: The Retired Emperor's sons Jianqing and Jianchun were enfeoffed as Prince of Rong and Prince of Xu.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，築沙灣堤成。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the Shawan embankment was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the Shawan embankment was finished.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，河南流民復業者，計口給食五年。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, for Henan refugees who returned to their occupations, rations were issued by head for five years.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou refugees in Henan who went back to farming were given grain by head for five years.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，官顏、孟二氏子孫各一人。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, one descendant each of the Yan and Meng clans was given office.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi one descendant each of the houses of Yan and Mencius was appointed to office.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，罷各省巡撫官入京議事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yihai, provincial grand coordinators were abolished from coming to the capital for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai, provincial grand coordinators were no longer summoned to the capital for joint deliberation.

sentences.zh: 是月，大雨，河決沙灣。

translations.literal: That month, heavy rain burst the Yellow River at Shawan.
translations.idiomatic: That month torrential rain broke the Yellow River at Shawan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙未，左都御史王總督兩廣軍務。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day yiwei, Censor-in-Chief Wang Ao was made supreme commander of military affairs in the Two Guangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yiwei, Censor-in-Chief Wang Ao was put in overall command of the Two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，王一寧卒。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Wang Yining died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Wang Yining died.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，振徐、兗水災。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yichou, Xu and Yan were relieved for flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yichou, grain relief was sent to the flood districts of Xu and Yan.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，都御史洪英，尚書孫原貞、薛希璉等分行天下，考察官吏。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Censor-in-Chief Hong Ying and Ministers Sun Yuanzhen and Xue Xilian, among others, were sent through the realm in separate parties to inspect officials.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Censor-in-Chief Hong Ying and Ministers Sun Yuanzhen and Xue Xilian, among others, were dispatched across the provinces to examine local officials.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，振兩畿水災州縣，免稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the Two Capitals districts' flood-stricken counties were relieved, and tax grain was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou flood districts in both capital regions received relief and had grain tax waived.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，振南畿、河南、山東流民。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, refugees in the southern capital region, Henan, and Shandong were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou relief was opened for displaced people in the southern capital region, Henan, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，江淵起復。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day gengyin, Jiang Yuan was recalled from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengyin, Jiang Yuan was recalled from mourning.

sentences.zh: [二]辛卯，以南京地震，兩淮大水，河決，命都御史王文巡視安輯。

translations.literal: [2] On the day xinmao, because of the Nanjing earthquake, great floods in the Two Huai districts, and the river breach, Censor-in-Chief Wang Wen was ordered to tour the regions and settle the people.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, after the Nanjing earthquake, flooding on the Two Huai, and the river breach, Censor-in-Chief Wang Wen was sent to tour the stricken districts and restore order.

sentences.zh: 乙未，振兩畿、山東、山西、福建、廣西、江西、遼東被災州縣。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, disaster-stricken counties in the Two Capitals districts, Shandong, Shanxi, Fujian, Guangxi, Jiangxi, and Liaodong were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei relief was sent to stricken counties in both capital regions, Shandong, Shanxi, Fujian, Guangxi, Jiangxi, and Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸未，開處州銀場。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day guiwei, the Chuzhou silver mines were opened.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on guiwei, the Chuzhou silver mines were opened.

sentences.zh: 是月，福建盜起。

translations.literal: That month, bandits rose in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: That month banditry broke out in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，左都御史王文兼翰林學士，直文淵閣，預機務。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day wuxu, Censor-in-Chief Wang Wen was concurrently made a Hanlin academician, entered the Grand Secretariat, and participated in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuxu, Censor-in-Chief Wang Wen was also appointed Hanlin academician, entered the Grand Secretariat, and joined in state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，都督孫鏜、僉事石彪協守大同，都督同知潁，僉事楊能、張欽協守宣府，備也先。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Regional Commander Sun Tang and Commissioner Shi Biao jointly defended Datong; Vice Commander Wei Ying and Commissioners Yang Neng and Zhang Qin jointly defended Xuanfu, in preparation against Esen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Regional Commander Sun Tang and Commissioner Shi Biao held Datong together; Vice Commander Wei Ying with Commissioners Yang Neng and Zhang Qin held Xuanfu against Esen.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the new moon day jiwei, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the new moon of the eleventh month, jiwei, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，都督方瑛平白石崖諸苗。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Regional Commander Fang Ying pacified the Miao of White Stone Cliff and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Regional Commander Fang Ying pacified the Miao at White Stone Cliff and neighboring strongholds.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，安輯畿內、山東、山西逃民，復賦役五年。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, fugitive people in the metropolitan districts, Shandong, and Shanxi were settled; tax and corvée obligations were restored after five years.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu fugitives in the capital region, Shandong, and Shanxi were resettled, with tax and labor duties deferred for five years.

sentences.zh: 是月，免山東及淮、徐水災稅糧。

translations.literal: That month, disaster-stricken tax grain in Shandong and the Huai and Xu districts was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month grain tax was waived in the flood districts of Shandong and the Huai and Xu region.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，始立團營，太監阮讓、都督楊俊等分統之，聽于謙、石亨、太監劉永誠、曹吉祥節制。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day guisi, regimented camps were first established; the eunuch Ruan Rang, Regional Commander Yang Jun, and others were assigned to command them in separate divisions, under the control of Yu Qian, Shi Heng, and the eunuchs Liu Yongcheng and Cao Jixiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guisi, regimented camps were first formed; Eunuch Ruan Rang, Regional Commander Yang Jun, and others were given separate commands, subject to Yu Qian, Shi Heng, and the eunuchs Liu Yongcheng and Cao Jixiang.

sentences.zh: 是月，免河南及永平被災秋糧。

translations.literal: That month, autumn grain was remitted in disaster-stricken Henan and Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: That month autumn grain tax was waived in stricken Henan and Yongping.

sentences.zh: 是年，瓦剌、琉球中山、爪哇、暹羅、安南、哈密、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, the Oirats, Ryukyu Chuzan, Java, Siam, Annam, Hami, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies came from the Oirats, Ryukyu Chuzan, Java, Siam, Annam, Hami, and Tibet.

sentences.zh: 景泰四年

translations.literal: The fourth year of Jingtai.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth year of the Jingtai reign.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月辛未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the day xinwei, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the first month of spring, on xinwei, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，五開、清浪諸苗復叛，梁、王來討之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day wuzi, the Miao of Wukai, Qinglang, and other districts rebelled again; Liang Yu and Wang Lai campaigned against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuzi, the Miao of Wukai, Qinglang, and neighboring districts rose again; Liang Yu and Wang Lai marched against them.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，免江西去年被災秋糧。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, last year's disaster-stricken autumn grain in Jiangxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu autumn grain tax was forgiven in last year's disaster districts of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，開建寧銀場。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuyin, the Jianning silver mines were opened.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuyin, the Jianning silver mines were opened.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，築沙灣決口。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day wuzi, the Shawan breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuzi, the Shawan breach was closed.

sentences.zh: 運南京倉粟振徐州。

translations.literal: Grain from the Nanjing granaries was transported to relieve Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Grain from the Nanjing granaries was shipped to relieve Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，發徐、淮倉振饑民。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dingsi, the Xu and Huai granaries were opened to relieve the starving people.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingsi, the Xu and Huai granaries were opened for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 己巳，王文起復。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Wang Wen was recalled from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Wang Wen was recalled from mourning.

sentences.zh: [三]甲戌，徐州復大水，民益饑。

translations.literal: [3] On the day jiaxu, Xuzhou was flooded again and the people grew hungrier still.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Xuzhou flooded again and hunger deepened.

sentences.zh: 發支運及鹽課糧振之。

translations.literal: Transport grain from branch routes and salt-tax grain were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Grain from branch transport routes and from the salt levy was issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，發淮安倉振鳳陽。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the Huai'an granary was opened to relieve Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the Huai'an granary was opened to relieve Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，沙灣河復決。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the Shawan River burst again.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Shawan River broke its banks again.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，吏部尚書何文淵以給事中林聰言下獄，尋令致仕。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renchen, Minister of Personnel He Wenyuan was cast into prison because of a memorial by Supervising Secretary Lin Cong; before long he was ordered to retire.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renchen, Personnel Minister He Wenyuan was jailed on a charge raised by Supervising Secretary Lin Cong and soon ordered to retire.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，瘞土木、大同、紫荊關暴骸。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the exposed remains at Tumu, Datong, and Zijing Pass were buried.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the unburied dead at Tumu, Datong, and Zijing Pass were interred.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，停諸不急工役。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day gengchen, all non-urgent labor corvées were halted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengchen, every nonessential public work was stopped.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，振河南饑。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jichou, Henan famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jichou, relief was sent to famine victims in Henan.

sentences.zh: 甲午，也先自立為可汗。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Esen declared himself khan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Esen proclaimed himself khan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅，詔天下鎮守、巡撫官督課農桑。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day gengyin, an edict ordered frontier garrison commanders and grand coordinators throughout the realm to supervise agriculture and sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengyin, the throne ordered every frontier garrison commander and grand coordinator to press farming and silkworm raising.

sentences.zh: 甲午，諭德徐有貞為左僉都御史，[四]治沙灣決河。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Lecturing Mentor Xu Youzhen was made Left Vice Censor-in-Chief [4] to manage the Shawan river breach.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Lecturing Mentor Xu Youzhen was made left vice censor-in-chief to take charge of the Shawan breach.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，也先遣使來。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Esen dispatched envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Esen sent envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，皇太子見濟薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day xinwei, the Crown Prince Jianji died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinwei, Crown Prince Jianji died.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，免山東被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yiwei, disaster-stricken tax grain in Shandong was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yiwei, grain tax was waived in the disaster districts of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賚邊軍。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, frontier troops were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the frontier armies were given bounty gifts.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球中山、安南、爪哇、日本、占城、哈密、瓦剌入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu Chuzan, Annam, Java, Japan, Champa, Hami, and the Oirats sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies came from Ryukyu Chuzan, Annam, Java, Japan, Champa, Hami, and the Oirats.

sentences.zh: 景泰五年

translations.literal: The fifth year of Jingtai.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth year of the Jingtai reign.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月戊午，黃河清，自龍門至於芮城。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on the day wuwu, the Yellow River ran clear from Longmen to Ruicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the first month of spring, on wuwu, the Yellow River ran clear from Longmen to Ruicheng.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 壬申，罷福州、建寧銀場。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the Fuzhou and Jianning silver mines were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Fuzhou and Jianning silver mines were shut.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，平江侯陳豫、學士江淵撫輯山東、河南被災軍民。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Marquis of Pingjiang Chen Yu and Academician Jiang Yuan settled the troops and people stricken in Shandong and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Marquis of Pingjiang Chen Yu and Academician Jiang Yuan were sent to restore order among troops and civilians stricken in Shandong and Henan.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，以雨暘弗時，詔修省，求直言。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yisi, because rain and sunshine were untimely, austerity and self-examination were ordered and forthright counsel was sought.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yisi, with the seasons out of balance, the Emperor ordered rectification and called for blunt memorials.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，賜孫賢等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renzi, Sun Xian and others were granted jinshi with metropolitan graduate and lower degrees in graded ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renzi, Sun Xian and other jinshi received metropolitan graduate and lower degrees in graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，學士江淵振淮北饑民。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Academician Jiang Yuan relieved famine among the people north of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Academician Jiang Yuan sent relief to famine victims north of the Huai.

sentences.zh: 王文撫卹南畿。

translations.literal: Wang Wen comforted and consoled the Southern Capital district.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wen comforted and consoled the Southern Capital district.

sentences.zh: 甲子，總督兩廣副都御史馬昂破瀧水瑤。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Ma Ang, vice censor-in-chief supervising Guangdong and Guangxi, defeated the Longshui Yao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Ma Ang, vice censor-in-chief over the Two Guangs, defeated the Longshui Yao.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，緬甸執獻思機發。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Burma seized Si Jifa.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Burma seized Si Jifa.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the first day renwu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the new-moon day renwu, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，方瑛破草塘苗，封瑛南和伯。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Fang Ying defeated the Caotang Miao; Fang was enfeoffed Marquis of Nanhe.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Fang Ying routed the Caotang Miao and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Nanhe.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，禮部郎中章綸、御史鍾同以請復沂王為皇太子下錦衣獄。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jiazi, Bureau Director Zhang Lun of the Ministry of Rites and Censor Zhong Tong, for begging restoration of the Prince of Qi as crown prince, were sent to the Embroidered Uniform Guard prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiazi, Zhang Lun of the Ministry of Rites and Censor Zhong Tong, for begging that the Prince of Qi be restored as crown prince, were cast into the Embroidered Uniform Guard prison.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，錄囚。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day wuzi, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuzi, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，振南畿水災。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day guiyou, relief was sent for flood disaster in the Southern Capital district.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiyou, grain relief was sent to flood-stricken districts of the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，復命天下巡撫官赴京師議事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day dingyou, touring commissioners throughout the realm were again ordered to come to the capital for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingyou, touring commissioners throughout the realm were again ordered to the capital for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，免蘇、松、常、揚、杭、嘉、湖漕糧二百餘萬石。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renxu, more than two million shi of grain transport tax were remitted for Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Yangzhou, Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renxu, more than two million shi of transport grain were remitted for Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Yangzhou, Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰，副都御史劉廣衡巡撫浙江、福建，專司討賊。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day gengchen, Vice Censor-in-chief Liu Guangheng toured and pacified Zhejiang and Fujian, charged solely with suppressing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengchen, Vice Censor-in-chief Liu Guangheng was assigned to tour Zhejiang and Fujian, charged solely with suppressing bandits.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，罷蘇、松、常、鎮織造採辦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day wuwu, weaving procurement for Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuwu, imperial weaving procurement for Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十二月，免南畿、浙江被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, disaster tax grain of the Southern Capital district and Zhejiang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, disaster tax grain was remitted in the Southern Capital district and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、琉球中山、爪哇入貢。

translations.literal: That year Annam, Ryukyu Zhongshan, and Java paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam, Ryukyu's Zhongshan domain, and Java sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 也先為知院阿剌所殺。

translations.literal: Esen was killed by the yiyuan Alai.
translations.idiomatic: Esen was killed by Alai the yiyuan.

sentences.zh: 景泰六年

translations.literal: Jingtai year six.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 6

sentences.zh: 六年春正月戊午，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring of the sixth year, the first month, on the day wuwu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the sixth year, the first month, on wuwu, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，太監王誠同法司、刑科錄囚。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day renwu, the eunuch Wang Cheng together with the judiciary and the Penal Affairs section reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renwu, the eunuch Wang Cheng joined the judiciary and the Penal Affairs section in reviewing prisoners.

sentences.zh: 大理少卿李茂等錄南京、浙江囚。

translations.literal: Assistant Director of the Court of Judicial Review Li Mao and others reviewed prisoners in Nanjing and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mao, assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review, and others reviewed prisoners in Nanjing and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the first day bingzi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the new-moon day bingzi, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，敕戶、兵二部及兩畿、山東、河南、浙江、湖廣撫、按、三司官條寬卹事，罷不急諸務。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, an edict charged the Ministries of Revenue and War and the touring commissioners, surveillance commissioners, and provincial administrations of the Two Capitals districts, Shandong, Henan, Zhejiang, and Huguang to set forth lenient relief measures and abolish non-urgent tasks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi an edict charged the Ministries of Revenue and War and the touring and surveillance officials and provincial administrations of the Two Capitals districts, Shandong, Henan, Zhejiang, and Huguang to lay out lenient relief measures and abolish non-urgent tasks.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，禱雨於南郊。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jisi, rain was prayed for at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jisi, rain was prayed for at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，宋儒朱熹裔孫梃為翰林院世襲五經博士。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yihai, Ting, descendant of the Song Confucian Zhu Xi, was made hereditary Five Classics doctor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai, Ting, descendant of the Song Confucian Zhu Xi, was appointed hereditary Five Classics doctor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 癸未，河決開封。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the Yellow River burst its banks at Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the Yellow River burst its banks at Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，沙灣決口隄成。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day yihai, the Sha Bay breach dike was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yihai, the Sha Bay breach dike was completed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以南京災異屢見，敕臣修省。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, because omens and disasters repeatedly appeared at Nanjing, an edict ordered officials to undertake self-reform.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, because omens and disasters repeatedly appeared at Nanjing, the throne ordered officials to undertake self-reform.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，南京大理少卿廖莊以請復沂王為皇太子，杖於闕下，杖章綸、鍾同於獄，同卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengshen, Nanjing Assistant Director of the Court of Judicial Review Liao Zhuang, for begging restoration of the Prince of Qi as crown prince, was beaten at the palace gate; Zhang Lun and Zhong Tong were beaten again in prison, and Zhong Tong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengshen, Liao Zhuang, Nanjing assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review, for begging that the Prince of Qi be restored as crown prince, was beaten at the palace gate; Zhang Lun and Zhong Tong were beaten again in prison, and Zhong Tong died.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，振蘇、松饑民米麥一百餘萬石。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day yihai, more than a million shi of rice and wheat were sent to relieve famine among the people of Suzhou and Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yihai, more than a million shi of rice and wheat were sent to relieve famine in Suzhou and Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，免陝西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day wuwu, Shaanxi's disaster tax grain was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu, Shaanxi's disaster tax grain was remitted.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，南和伯方瑛為平蠻將軍充總兵官，討湖廣苗。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yihai, Fang Ying, Marquis of Nanhe, was made General Who Pacifies the Miao and appointed overall commander to campaign against the Miao of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yihai, Fang Ying, Marquis of Nanhe, was made General Who Pacifies the Miao and overall commander to campaign against the Huguang Miao.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳，免南畿被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jisi, autumn grain tax of the Southern Capital district stricken by disaster was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jisi, autumn grain tax was remitted in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球中山、暹羅、哈密、滿剌加入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu Zhongshan, Siam, Hami, and Malacca paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu's Zhongshan domain, Siam, Hami, and Malacca sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 景泰七年

translations.literal: Jingtai year seven.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 7

sentences.zh: 七年春正月己卯，尚書石璞撫安湖廣軍民。

translations.literal: In spring of the seventh year, the first month, on the day jimao, Minister Shi Pu pacified the armies and people of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the seventh year, the first month, on jimao, Minister Shi Pu pacified the armies and people of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，皇后崩。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengshen, the Empress died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen, the Empress died.

sentences.zh: 甲子，營壽陵。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, construction of the Longevity Mausoleum was begun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi work began on the Longevity Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，免雲南被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuyin, Yunnan's disaster tax grain was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuyin, Yunnan's disaster tax grain was remitted.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊寅，以水旱災異，敕內外諸臣修省。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on the day wuyin, because of flood, drought, and omens, an edict ordered officials within and without to undertake self-reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on wuyin, because of flood, drought, and omens, the throne ordered officials within and without the court to undertake self-reform.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，宋儒周敦頤裔孫冕為翰林院世襲五經博士。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Mian, descendant of the Song Confucian Zhou Dunyi, was made hereditary Five Classics doctor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Mian, descendant of the Song Confucian Zhou Dunyi, was appointed hereditary Five Classics doctor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，葬肅孝皇后。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengshen, Empress Su-Xiao was buried.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengshen, Empress Su-Xiao was buried.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，振江西饑。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guimao, Jiangxi famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guimao, grain relief was sent to famine in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，方瑛大破湖廣苗。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jihai, Fang Ying inflicted a great defeat on the Miao of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jihai, Fang Ying inflicted a great defeat on the Huguang Miao.

sentences.zh: 戊午，振畿內、山東、河南水災。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, flood disaster in the capital districts and in Shandong and Henan was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu grain relief was sent to flood disaster in the capital districts and in Shandong and Henan.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，帝不豫，罷明年元旦朝賀。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the Emperor fell ill; next year's New Year court audience was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Emperor fell ill, and next year's New Year court audience was abolished.

sentences.zh: 是冬，免畿內、山東被災稅糧，並蠲逋賦。

translations.literal: That winter disaster tax grain of the capital districts and Shandong was remitted, and overdue levies were forgiven as well.
translations.idiomatic: That winter disaster tax grain was remitted in the capital districts and Shandong, and overdue levies were forgiven as well.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球中山、撒馬兒罕、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu Zhongshan, Samarkand, and Tibet paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu's Zhongshan domain, Samarkand, and Tibet sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 景泰八年

translations.literal: Jingtai year eight.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 8

sentences.zh: 八年春正月戊辰，免江西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In spring of the eighth year, the first month, on the day wuchen, Jiangxi's disaster tax grain was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the eighth year, the first month, on wuchen, Jiangxi's disaster tax grain was remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，帝輿疾宿南郊齋宮。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the Emperor, ill, lodged overnight in the fasting lodge of the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the Emperor, stricken with illness, lodged overnight in the Southern Suburb fasting lodge.

sentences.zh: 己卯，臣請建太子，不聽。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, officials begged that a crown prince be established; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao officials begged that a crown prince be established; the Emperor would not consent.

sentences.zh: 壬午，武清侯石亨、副都御史徐有貞等迎上皇復位。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Military Marquis Shi Heng, Vice Censor-in-chief Xu Youzhen, and others welcomed the Retired Emperor to restoration.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Military Marquis Shi Heng, Vice Censor-in-chief Xu Youzhen, and others welcomed the Retired Emperor back to the throne.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，廢帝為郕王，遷西內，皇太后吳氏以下悉仍舊號。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yiwei, the Emperor was deposed as Prince of Cheng and moved to the Western Palace; the Grand Empress Dowager Lady Wu and those below all resumed their former titles.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiwei, the Emperor was deposed as Prince of Cheng and moved to the Western Palace; Grand Empress Dowager Wu and those below all resumed their former titles.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，王薨於西宮，年三十。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the Prince died in the Western Palace, aged thirty.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the Prince died in the Western Palace, aged thirty.

sentences.zh: 諡曰戾。

translations.literal: The posthumous title Li was raised.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Li.

sentences.zh: 毀所營壽陵，以親王禮葬西山，給武成中軍二百戶守護。

translations.literal: The Longevity Mausoleum under construction was destroyed; he was buried on the Western Hills by princely rite, and two hundred households of the Wu-cheng Central Army were assigned to guard the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: The Longevity Mausoleum then under construction was torn down; he was buried on the Western Hills by princely rite, and two hundred households of the Wu-cheng Central Army were assigned to guard the tomb.

sentences.zh: 成化十一年十二月戊子，制曰：「朕叔郕王踐阼，戡難保邦，奠安宗社，殆將八載。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the eleventh year of Chenghua, on the day wuzi, an edict said: "Our uncle the Prince of Cheng took the throne, quelled crisis and preserved the state, and settled altar and land—nearly eight years.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Chenghua 11, on wuzi, an edict said, "Our uncle the Prince of Cheng took the throne, quelled crisis and preserved the state, and settled altar and land—nearly eight years.

sentences.zh: 彌留之際，奸臣貪功，妄興讒構，請削帝號。

translations.literal: In his final illness crafty ministers, greedy for merit, falsely raised slander and asked that his imperial title be struck.
translations.idiomatic: In his final illness crafty ministers, greedy for merit, falsely raised slander and asked that his imperial title be struck.

sentences.zh: 先帝旋知其枉，每用悔恨，以次抵諸奸於法，不幸上賓，未及舉正。

translations.literal: The late emperor soon knew their wrong; he often repented, and in turn brought the traitors to justice; alas he ascended on high before the wrong could be fully righted.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor soon knew their wrong; he often repented and in turn brought the traitors to justice; alas he ascended on high before the wrong could be fully righted.

sentences.zh: 朕敦念親親，用成先志，可仍皇帝之號，其議諡以聞。

translations.literal: We, cherishing kinship, fulfill his intent: his imperial title may stand; deliberate his posthumous title and report.
translations.idiomatic: We, cherishing kinship, fulfill his intent: his imperial title may stand; deliberate his posthumous title and report.

sentences.zh: 」遂上尊諡。

translations.literal: " Thereupon supreme posthumous honors were raised.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon supreme posthumous honors were raised.

sentences.zh: 敕有司繕陵寢，祭饗視諸陵。

translations.literal: An edict charged the relevant offices to repair the mausoleum; sacrifices were to follow the rites of the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict charged the relevant offices to repair the mausoleum; sacrifices were to follow the rites of the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：景帝當倥傯之時，奉命居攝，旋正大位以繫人心，事之權而得其正者也。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: When the Jingtai Emperor faced desperate crisis, he accepted commission as regent and soon took the throne formally to steady men's hearts—an expedient rightly taken.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: When the Jingtai Emperor faced desperate crisis, he accepted commission as regent and soon took the throne formally to steady men's hearts—an expedient rightly taken.

sentences.zh: 篤任賢能，勵精政治，強寇深入而宗社乂安，再造之績良云偉矣。

translations.literal: He trusted worthies earnestly, applied himself to government, and though fierce enemies drove deep within the realm the altar and land knew peace again; the merit of restoration was indeed great.
translations.idiomatic: He trusted worthies earnestly and applied himself to government; though fierce enemies drove deep within the realm, altar and land knew peace again—the merit of restoration was indeed great.

sentences.zh: 而乃汲汲易儲，南內深錮，朝謁不許，恩誼恝然。

translations.literal: Yet he pressed urgently to change the heir, held the Southern Palace under stern lock, forbade court audience, and kindness between kin grew cold.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he pressed urgently to change the heir, held the Southern Palace under stern lock, forbade court audience, and kindness between kin grew cold.

sentences.zh: 終於輿疾齋宮，小人乘間竊發，事起倉猝，不克以令名終。

translations.literal: At last, sick in the fasting lodge of the suburban altar, petty men seized the interval to strike; the affair rose in haste and he could not end with a fair name.
translations.idiomatic: At last, sick in the suburban fasting lodge, petty men seized the interval to strike; the affair rose in haste and he could not end with a fair name.

sentences.zh: 惜夫！

translations.literal: A pity!
translations.idiomatic: A pity!

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Collation notes

sentences.zh: [一] 右通政王復太常少卿趙榮使也先營 趙榮，原作「王榮」。

translations.literal: [1] Right Vice Minister of Communications Wang Fu and Vice Minister of Rites Zhao Rong were sent to Esen's camp — Zhao Rong: the original text read "Wang Rong."
translations.idiomatic: [1] "Right Vice Minister of Communications Wang Fu and Vice Minister of Rites Zhao Rong were sent to Esen's camp": Zhao Rong, the original text read "Wang Rong."

sentences.zh: 明史稿紀九景帝紀、英宗實錄卷一八四同。

translations.literal: Draft History of the Ming, Annals 9, Account of the Jingtai Emperor, and Veritable Records of Emperor Yingzong, fascicle 184, agree.
translations.idiomatic: The Draft History of the Ming, Annals 9, Account of the Jingtai Emperor, and the Yingzong Shilu, juan 184, agree.

sentences.zh: 按本書卷一七○于謙傳、又卷一七七王復傳，國榷卷二八頁一八○四都作「趙榮」。

translations.literal: Per this book, juan 170, Biography of Yu Qian, and again juan 177, Biography of Wang Fu, and Guoque, juan 28, page 1804, all read "Zhao Rong."
translations.idiomatic: Per this book, juan 170, Biography of Yu Qian, and juan 177, Biography of Wang Fu, and Guoque, juan 28, p. 1804, all read "Zhao Rong."

sentences.zh: 本書卷一七一楊善傳附有趙榮傳，事跡與紀合。

translations.literal: This book, juan 171, Biography of Yang Shan, appends a biography of Zhao Rong; his deeds agree with the annals.
translations.idiomatic: This book, juan 171, Biography of Yang Shan, appends a biography of Zhao Rong; his deeds agree with the annals.

sentences.zh: 明史稿、英宗實錄顯蒙上文「王復」的「王」字而誤，今改正。

translations.literal: The Draft History and the Veritable Records of Yingzong plainly took the "Wang" of "Wang Fu" above in error; emended accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: The Draft History and the Yingzong Shilu plainly took the "Wang" of "Wang Fu" above in error; emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: [二] 九月庚寅江淵起復 按本書卷一○九宰輔年表、英宗實錄卷二二○都作「九月奔喪」，宰輔年表作四年「四月還任」，是起復在下一年四月，紀文疑有誤。

translations.literal: [2] On gengyin Jiang Yuan returned to office — per this book, juan 109, Chronological Table of Chief Ministers, and Veritable Records of Yingzong, fascicle 220, both read "in the ninth month, mourning leave," and the Chronological Table of Chief Ministers records "returned to office in the fourth month" of the fourth year; thus return to office was in the fourth month of the following year; the annals text is suspect.
translations.idiomatic: [2] "On gengyin Jiang Yuan returned to office": per this book, juan 109, Chronological Table of Chief Ministers, and the Yingzong Shilu, juan 220, both read "in the ninth month, mourning leave," and the Chronological Table records "returned to office in the fourth month" of the fourth year; return to office was thus in the fourth month of the following year; the annals text is suspect.

sentences.zh: [三] 己巳王文起復 按本書卷一○九宰輔年表記王文事，作「五月丁憂，九月起復」。

translations.literal: [3] On jisi Wang Wen returned to office — per this book, juan 109, Chronological Table of Chief Ministers, recording Wang Wen's affairs, reads "fifth month, mourning; ninth month, returned to office."
translations.idiomatic: [3] "On jisi Wang Wen returned to office": per this book, juan 109, Chronological Table of Chief Ministers, recording Wang Wen's affairs, reads "fifth month, mourning; ninth month, returned to office."

sentences.zh: 英宗實錄卷二二九繫王文丁母憂奔喪於五月己巳，繫王文起復於九月甲寅。

translations.literal: Veritable Records of Yingzong, fascicle 229, places Wang Wen's mourning for his mother and departure on jisi of the fifth month, and his return to office on jiayin of the ninth month.
translations.idiomatic: The Yingzong Shilu, juan 229, places Wang Wen's mourning for his mother and departure on jisi of the fifth month, and his return to office on jiayin of the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 此記起復於五月己巳，合二事為一，顯有脫訛。

translations.literal: Here return to office is recorded on jisi of the fifth month, combining two events into one; there is plainly lacuna and corruption.
translations.idiomatic: Here return to office is recorded on jisi of the fifth month, combining two events into one; there is plainly lacuna and corruption.

sentences.zh: [四] 諭德徐有貞為左僉都御史 左僉都御史，本書卷一七一徐有貞傳、國榷卷三一頁一九六六同。

translations.literal: [4] Lecturer Xu Youzhen was made Left Vice Censor-in-chief — Left Vice Censor-in-chief: this book, juan 171, Biography of Xu Youzhen, and Guoque, juan 31, page 1966, agree.
translations.idiomatic: [4] "Lecturer Xu Youzhen was made Left Vice Censor-in-chief": Left Vice Censor-in-chief—this book, juan 171, Biography of Xu Youzhen, and Guoque, juan 31, p. 1966, agree.

sentences.zh: 明史稿紀九景帝紀及英宗實錄卷二三四均作「右僉都御史」。

translations.literal: Draft History of the Ming, Annals 9, Account of the Jingtai Emperor, and Veritable Records of Yingzong, fascicle 234, both read "Right Vice Censor-in-chief."
translations.idiomatic: The Draft History of the Ming, Annals 9, Account of the Jingtai Emperor, and the Yingzong Shilu, juan 234, both read "Right Vice Censor-in-chief."

sentences.zh: 按本書及官銜，「左」「右」往往相混，以後此類不再出校記。

translations.literal: Per this book and official titles, "Left" and "Right" are often confused; hereafter such cases will no longer receive collation notes.
translations.idiomatic: Per this book and official titles, "Left" and "Right" are often confused; hereafter such cases will no longer receive collation notes.
